revivalblessing.Name: Revival Blessing
revivalblessing.ZMoveEffect: resets lowered stats of the user
revivalblessing.Desc: Revives the first fainted ally in party order with half of its maximum HP.

saltcure.Name: Salt Cure
saltcure.Desc: Salt cures the target after a hit, damaging it each turn by 1/8 max HP, or 1/4 if it is Water or Steel type.

tripledive.Name: Triple Dive
tripledive.Desc: The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting the target three times in a row.

mortalspin.Name: Mortal Spin
mortalspin.Desc: The user spins to remove binding effects and hazards, poisons targets, and raises its Speed by one stage.

doodle.Name: Doodle
doodle.Desc: The user copies the target’s effective Ability for itself and each active ally.

filletaway.Name: Fillet Away
filletaway.ZMoveEffect: resets lowered stats of the user
filletaway.Desc: The user loses half its maximum HP to raise its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed by two stages each.

kowtowcleave.Name: Kowtow Cleave
kowtowcleave.Desc: The user kowtows to make the target lower its guard, then slashes. This attack never misses.

flowertrick.Name: Flower Trick
flowertrick.Desc: The user throws a rigged bouquet at the target. This never misses and always lands a critical hit.

torchsong.Name: Torch Song
torchsong.Desc: The user sings with raging flames to scorch the target. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

aquastep.Name: Aqua Step
aquastep.Desc: The user attacks with light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user’s Speed stat.

ragingbull.Name: Raging Bull
ragingbull.Desc: The user’s Paldean Tauros form determines this move’s type. The attack also destroys the target side’s screens.

makeitrain.Name: Make It Rain
makeitrain.Desc: The user attacks by throwing out a mass of coins. This lowers its Sp. Atk, but earns money after battle.

psyblade.Name: Psyblade
psyblade.Desc: The user rends the target with an ethereal blade. Its power rises by 50 percent on Electric Terrain.

hydrosteam.Name: Hydro Steam
hydrosteam.Desc: The user blasts boiling-hot water. In harsh sunlight, its power is boosted instead of lowered.

ruination.Name: Ruination
ruination.Desc: The user summons a ruinous disaster. This cuts the target’s HP in half.

collisioncourse.Name: Collision Course
collisioncourse.Desc: The user transforms and crashes into the target. Its power is boosted by one third if the move is super effective.

electrodrift.Name: Electro Drift
electrodrift.Desc: The user races forward and attacks with electricity. Its power is boosted by one third if super effective.

shedtail.Name: Shed Tail
shedtail.ZMoveEffect: resets lowered stats of the user
shedtail.Desc: The user spends half its maximum HP to create a substitute, then passes that substitute to a party member.

chillyreception.Name: Chilly Reception
chillyreception.Desc: The user tells a chillingly bad joke, summons hail for five turns, then switches places with a party Pokémon.

tidyup.Name: Tidy Up
tidyup.Desc: Removes hazards from both sides and all active substitutes, then raises the user’s Attack and Speed by one.

snowscape.Name: Snowscape
snowscape.Desc: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except Ice types.

pounce.Name: Pounce
pounce.Desc: The user pounces on the target suddenly. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

trailblaze.Name: Trailblaze
trailblaze.Desc: The user attacks as if leaping out from tall grass. This also boosts the user’s Speed stat.

chillingwater.Name: Chilling Water
chillingwater.Desc: The user showers the target with water so cold it saps its power. This also lowers the target’s Attack.

hyperdrill.Name: Hyper Drill
hyperdrill.Desc: The user spins its pointed parts into the target. This move strikes through Protect and Detect.

twinbeam.Name: Twin Beam
twinbeam.Desc: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes. The target is hit twice in a row.

ragefist.Name: Rage Fist
ragefist.Desc: Power starts at 50 and rises by 50 each time the user is hit after first selecting this move, up to 350.

armorcannon.Name: Armor Cannon
armorcannon.Desc: The user shoots off its armor as blazing projectiles. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

bitterblade.Name: Bitter Blade
bitterblade.Desc: The user focuses its bitter feelings into a slash. Its HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

doubleshock.Name: Double Shock
doubleshock.Desc: The user discharges all its electricity. It must be Electric type and loses that type after a successful hit.

gigatonhammer.Name: Gigaton Hammer
gigatonhammer.Desc: The user swings its huge hammer with its whole body. This move cannot be used twice in a row.

comeuppance.Name: Comeuppance
comeuppance.Desc: The user retaliates with 1.5 times the damage it last received from an opponent.

aquacutter.Name: Aqua Cutter
aquacutter.Desc: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target. Critical hits land more easily.

blazingtorque.Name: Blazing Torque
blazingtorque.Desc: The user revs its blazing engine and attacks the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

wickedtorque.Name: Wicked Torque
wickedtorque.Desc: The user revs its wicked engine and attacks the target. This may also make the target fall asleep.

noxioustorque.Name: Noxious Torque
noxioustorque.Desc: The user revs its noxious engine and attacks the target. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.

combattorque.Name: Combat Torque
combattorque.Desc: The user revs its combat engine and attacks the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

magicaltorque.Name: Magical Torque
magicaltorque.Desc: The user revs its magical engine and attacks the target. This may also confuse the target.

bloodmoon.Name: Blood Moon
bloodmoon.Desc: The user unleashes the full brunt of a blood-red moon. This move cannot be used twice in a row.

matchagotcha.Name: Matcha Gotcha
matchagotcha.Desc: The user fires tea at opposing Pokémon and restores half the damage dealt. This may also leave them with a burn.

syrupbomb.Name: Syrup Bomb
syrupbomb.Desc: The user coats the target in syrup. Its Speed falls by one at the end of each of the next three turns.

ivycudgel.Name: Ivy Cudgel
ivycudgel.Desc: Ogerpon strikes with a cudgel. Its form changes this move to Grass, Water, Fire, or Rock type.

electroshot.Name: Electro Shot
electroshot.Desc: The user raises its Sp. Atk, then fires electricity on the next turn. In rain, it attacks immediately.

terastarstorm.Name: Tera Starstorm
terastarstorm.Desc: The user attacks the selected target with a 120-power special Normal move.

ficklebeam.Name: Fickle Beam
ficklebeam.Desc: The user fires a beam of light. There is a 30 percent chance that the move’s power will double.

burningbulwark.Name: Burning Bulwark
burningbulwark.Desc: Protects the user from attacks. If a contact move is blocked, the attacker is burned.

thunderclap.Name: Thunderclap
thunderclap.Desc: The user attacks first with electricity. It fails if the target is not readying an attack.

mightycleave.Name: Mighty Cleave
mightycleave.Desc: The user cleaves the target with horns of rock. This move strikes through Protect and Detect.

tachyoncutter.Name: Tachyon Cutter
tachyoncutter.Desc: The user launches particle blades at the target twice in a row. This attack never misses.

hardpress.Name: Hard Press
hardpress.Desc: The target is crushed with an arm. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move’s power.

dragoncheer.Name: Dragon Cheer
dragoncheer.ZMoveEffect: resets lowered stats of the user
dragoncheer.Desc: Raises allies’ critical-hit rank by one, or by two if the ally is Dragon type.

alluringvoice.Name: Alluring Voice
alluringvoice.Desc: The user attacks with an angelic voice. A target with any raised stat is also confused.

temperflare.Name: Temper Flare
temperflare.Desc: The user’s frustration fuels the attack. Power doubles if its previous attempted action did not succeed.

supercellslam.Name: Supercell Slam
supercellslam.Desc: The user electrifies its body and slams into the target. If it misses, the user is also hurt.

psychicnoise.Name: Psychic Noise
psychicnoise.Desc: The user attacks with an unpleasant sound wave. The target cannot recover HP for two turns.

upperhand.Name: Upper Hand
upperhand.Desc: A priority attack that makes the target flinch. It fails if the target did not select a damaging move.

malignantchain.Name: Malignant Chain
malignantchain.Desc: The user binds the target with a chain made of toxins. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.

nihillight.Name: Nihil Light
nihillight.Desc: The move ignores defensive stat changes and strikes a Dragon-type immunity for neutral damage.
